title: Agent Execution Readiness v1
description: Machine-readable agent execution readiness gate. Audits the agent loop, subagent runtime, supervisor, hardened tools, bash rerouting, context engine, Ralph, tracing, concurrency, resource budgets, content-light enforcement, adversarial coverage, and claim boundaries to produce a promote/park/reject recommendation.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for this readiness artifact.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this readiness artifact was generated.

trace_propagation.description: Trace propagation is active across the agent loop.

session_lifecycle.description: Session lifecycle management (init, reset, fork, finalize) is implemented and operational.

agent_loop_status.description: Status of the core agent loop subsystem.

task_lifecycle.description: Subagent task lifecycle (spawn, execute, complete, cancel) is implemented.

duplicate_completion_refused.description: Duplicate completion signals are detected and refused.

subagent_runtime_status.description: Status of the subagent runtime subsystem.

lifecycle_valid.description: Supervisor lifecycle (start, monitor, stop) is valid and test-covered.

lease_gated.description: Tool invocations are lease-gated through the supervisor.

env_scrubbed.description: Environment variables are scrubbed before subprocess execution.

runtime_supervisor_status.description: Status of the runtime supervisor subsystem.

receipts_for_allowed_ops.description: Receipts are generated for all allowed tool operations.

receipts_for_refused_ops.description: Receipts are generated for refused tool operations.

shell_true_refused.description: shell=True invocations are refused at the supervisor level.

subprocess_argv_array.description: Subprocess calls use argv arrays, not shell strings.
